US Bill Offers Easier Green Card Path for Indian Professionals

A new bill introduced in the United States proposes to create a more accessible route for Indian H-1B visa holders to obtain Green Cards. This legislative proposal is viewed as potentially significant for Indian professionals working in the US. The bill aims to streamline the process, offering a faster track to permanent residency for this group. Coverage highlights this as positive news for Indians seeking Green Cards.
